# Awesome MCP Servers

> Hand-curated, link-checked catalog of 522 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in 13 categories. Each entry has a URL, description, category, language, provider, tags, and an official flag. The website, JSON API, and these files are generated from the same data.

MCP is an open protocol that lets AI applications connect to external tools and data through a standardized client-server interface. This catalog lists well-scoped, source-available servers for databases, developer tools, browsers, cloud services, and more. Entries are reviewed for a clear purpose, a public source, and recent or official maintenance. Links are checked on every pull request and weekly.

Links under each category point at the upstream project, docs, or registry page. Use the Data section for the complete Markdown catalog and the JSON API. The Optional section is background an agent can skip.

## Data

- [Full catalog](https://mcphq.org/llms-full.txt): Every server in Markdown, with language, provider, tags, official status, and remote endpoints when listed.
- [Servers JSON](https://mcphq.org/api/servers.json): The same catalog as a JSON array.
- [Categories JSON](https://mcphq.org/api/categories.json): Category ids, names, and descriptions.
- [Server schema](https://github.com/mcpHQ/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/data/servers.schema.json): Allowed fields for each catalog entry.

## Official and Reference Servers

- [MCP Everything](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/everything): Reference server exposing prompts, resources, and tools for protocol testing. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Fetch](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/fetch): Fetch web content and convert HTML to markdown for LLM consumption. (Python, official)
- [MCP Filesystem](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/filesystem): Secure local filesystem access with configurable allowed directories. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Git](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/git): Read, search, and manipulate Git repositories through MCP tools. (Python, official)
- [MCP Inspector](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector): Visual testing tool for debugging MCP server capabilities and messages. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Memory](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/memory): Knowledge graph memory for persistent entities and relationships. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Python SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk): Official Python SDK for building MCP servers and clients. (Python, official)
- [MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry): Official MCP registry service and API for discovering publicly available MCP servers. (Go, official)
- [MCP Sequential Thinking](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/sequentialthinking): Structured step-by-step reasoning tool for complex problem solving. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Time](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/time): Time and timezone conversion utilities for agents and assistants. (Python, official)
- [MCP TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk): Official TypeScript SDK for building MCP servers and clients. (TypeScript, official)

## Databases and Storage

- [Chroma MCP Server](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma-mcp): Vector search and embedding storage with Chroma collections. (Python, official)
- [DBHub](https://github.com/bytebase/dbhub): Universal database gateway supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite, and MariaDB. (Go, official)
- [Elasticsearch MCP Server](https://github.com/elastic/mcp-server-elasticsearch): Search and analyze data in Elasticsearch clusters via MCP. (TypeScript, official)
- [HutchDB MCP Server](https://github.com/ExpeditedProjects/hutchdb): Shared database for teams and AI agents: store, query, and update structured records over MCP. (TypeScript, official)
- [MongoDB MCP Server](https://github.com/mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server): Query and manage MongoDB databases and collections from AI clients. (TypeScript, official)
- [MotherDuck MCP Server](https://github.com/motherduckdb/mcp-server-motherduck): Run analytical SQL queries against local DuckDB files and MotherDuck cloud databases. (Python, official)
- [Neon MCP Server](https://github.com/neondatabase/mcp-server-neon): Manage Neon Postgres databases, branches, and SQL queries via MCP. (TypeScript, official)
- [pgwarden](https://github.com/B0yko/pgwarden): Self-hosted PostgreSQL MCP gateway with OIDC login, per-user database roles, read-only queries, human-approved writes, and audit logging. (Python)
- [Pinecone MCP Server](https://github.com/pinecone-io/pinecone-mcp): Manage Pinecone indexes and run semantic vector queries. (TypeScript, official)
- [PlanetScale MCP Server](https://planetscale.com/docs/connect/mcp): Manage PlanetScale MySQL databases, branches, and schema changes. (TypeScript, official)
- [Prisma MCP Server](https://www.prisma.io/docs/ai/tools/mcp-server): Manage Prisma Postgres databases, Prisma Compute deployments, and Object Storage from AI tools through a remote MCP server. (Other, official)
- [Qdrant MCP Server](https://github.com/qdrant/mcp-server-qdrant): Store and retrieve vectors in Qdrant for RAG workflows. (Python, official)
- [Redis MCP Server](https://github.com/redis/mcp-redis): Read and write Redis keys, lists, and data structures through MCP. (Python, official)
- [RowSafe](https://github.com/rowsafe/rowsafe): Database health, backups, recovery and provisioning via local stdio or remote Streamable HTTP; requires a RowSafe account for the separate hosted service, with an Apache-2.0 agent, CLI and MCP server. (Go, official)
- [Snowflake MCP Server](https://github.com/Snowflake-Labs/mcp): Query Snowflake warehouses and manage data platform resources. (Python, official)
- [SQLite MCP Server](https://github.com/ktanaka101/mcp-server-duckdb): Lightweight SQLite database access for local development workflows. (Python)
- [Supabase MCP Server](https://github.com/supabase-community/supabase-mcp): Community-maintained integration for Supabase projects, tables, and auth through MCP tools. (TypeScript)

## Developer Tools and Code Intelligence

- [Harness MCP Server](https://github.com/harness/mcp-server): Official Harness.io MCP server for CI/CD pipelines, deployments, GitOps, and platform engineering workflows. (TypeScript, official)
- [Agent QA](https://github.com/vostride/agent-qa): Run natural-language web and mobile regression tests with persistent test memory through CLI and MCP interfaces. (TypeScript)
- [agent-chain-doctor](https://github.com/elfovo/agent-chain-doctor): Read-only diagnostic that inspects the scheduler config (launchd, cron, systemd) and trace files of a scheduled AI agent and reports which of 30 silent-failure modes it is exposed to. (Python)
- [AgentSandboxes](https://agentsandboxes.fyi): Search an index of cloud sandbox providers for AI agents: isolation, cold start, persistence, GPU support and pricing, each fact linked to its source. (TypeScript)
- [AgentTask Atlas](https://agenttaskatlas.com/mcp): Read-only, no-auth search over a curated catalog of MCP servers and Agent Skills organized by dev task, each with a one-line verdict, install command and source link. (TypeScript, official)
- [API.market MCP Gateway](https://api.market/mcp): Proprietary hosted OAuth gateway with five tools for API discovery, schemas, execution, usage and subscriptions; free tiers and paid plans vary by API. (TypeScript, official)
- [Apple Docs 2.0 MCP](https://github.com/mishafyi/Apple-Docs-2.0-MCP): Searches and reads Apple's developer documentation, Human Interface Guidelines and 1,700 WWDC sessions with code, with an offline index of 336,629 pages. (TypeScript)
- [AsItIs](https://github.com/Katta041/asitis-agent-tools): Read-only server that lints CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and SKILL.md against vendor rules, estimates the tokens they load per session, and flags hidden instructions such as comments addressed to the AI and invisible Unicode. (TypeScript, official)
- [ax](https://github.com/Necmttn/ax): Local-first MCP server for querying coding-agent sessions, tool calls, skills, and costs. (TypeScript)
- [Bestax](https://github.com/allxsmith/bestax/tree/main/bestax-mcp): Build Bulma v1 React apps with Bestax using an offline index of its component props, examples, CSS variables and Agent Skills. (TypeScript, official)
- [Chain.Love MCP](https://github.com/Chain-Love/chain.love-mcp): Hosted MCP gateway for searching and comparing Web3 infrastructure services, such as RPC, indexing, and oracle providers, by blockchain network. (Other, official)
- [Communicate](https://developer.communicate.so/docs/mcp): List workspace AI agents through a read-only hosted Streamable HTTP MCP server authenticated with OAuth client credentials. (TypeScript, official)
- [Concord MCP](https://github.com/Get-Concord-AI/concord-mcp): Local-first shared work-state for coding agents with presence, claims, messaging, handoffs, and review packets. (TypeScript)
- [Constitution Lint MCP Server](https://github.com/joeyycli/constitution-lint-action): Lints CLAUDE.md-style AI agent constitution files for missing operational guardrails: spend limits, injection defense, escalation paths, and secrets handling. (Python)
- [ContactLint](https://github.com/zksyncer/contactlint): Validate email syntax, DNS/MX over DoH, disposable domains, role addresses and typos, plus E.164 phone numbers via HTTP API and remote MCP, with no SMTP probing. (TypeScript, official)
- [Context7 MCP](https://github.com/upstash/context7): Up-to-date library and framework documentation injected into prompts. (TypeScript, official)
- [Docker MCP Server](https://github.com/docker/mcp-gateway): Manage containers, images, and Docker environments through MCP. (Go, official)
- [Docsy](https://github.com/getremcp/docsy-plugin): Retrieve version-specific developer documentation and original source links through five read-only remote MCP tools. (TypeScript, official)
- [E2B MCP Server](https://docs.e2b.dev/mcp): Secure cloud sandboxes with a built-in MCP gateway for running code and MCP tools in agent workflows. (Other, official)
- [ERIUS PHONE MCP](https://github.com/Protremix/erius-phone-mcp): Drive an ERIUS PHONE hosted Android phone or tablet: read the screen, tap, type, swipe, launch apps, install APKs, and pull crash logs. (Python, official)
- [Flare](https://flareapp.io/docs/flare/general/our-mcp-server): Investigate, resolve, snooze and assign errors, search logs, and find slow routes, queries and jobs in Flare, Spatie's error tracking and performance monitoring for Laravel and PHP. (PHP, official)
- [GitHub MCP Server](https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server): Official GitHub integration for repos, issues, pull requests, and code search. (Go, official)
- [GitLab MCP Server](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/gitlab_duo/model_context_protocol/mcp_server/): GitLab Duo MCP server for merge requests, issues, and project management. (Ruby, official)
- [GodotMCP](https://github.com/vberai/godot-mcp): A secure, 100% native GDScript Server-Sent Events (SSE) server bridging Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf directly to Godot 4.x scene trees. No Node.js or C# dependencies required. (GDScript)
- [installed-api](https://github.com/ajwann/installed-api): Answers API questions from the packages installed in the project: Python signatures, docstrings and source from the project's interpreter, TypeScript declarations from node_modules, and installed versions. (Python)
- [IntlPull MCP Server](https://intlpull.com/docs/mcp): Manage translation keys, translate strings, and sync localization files with IntlPull from MCP clients. (TypeScript, official)
- [ipvolt Proxy Toolkit](https://github.com/ipvolt/proxy-toolkit-mcp): Search reviewed proxy guides, generate tested proxy configuration templates for curl, Requests, HTTPX and Playwright, and diagnose proxy errors such as a 407 on CONNECT or a TLS failure. (TypeScript, official)
- [Kleap](https://github.com/kleaphq/cli): Create, edit, and publish websites from AI clients through a hosted MCP server. (JavaScript, official)
- [Kubernetes MCP Server](https://github.com/Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes): Operate Kubernetes clusters with kubectl-style MCP tools. (TypeScript)
- [Latchkey](https://latchkey.dev/documentation/connect-your-ai-agent): Official hosted MCP server for Latchkey's self-healing GitHub Actions runners: failure bundles with root cause and logs, run status, workflow dispatch, and one-off commands on fresh ephemeral runners. (Other, official)
- [Linear MCP Server](https://linear.app/docs/mcp): Create and manage Linear issues, projects, and team workflows. (TypeScript, official)
- [LynxPrompt MCP Server](https://github.com/GeiserX/lynxprompt-mcp): Browse, search, create and update LynxPrompt AI configuration blueprints (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md) on lynxprompt.com or a self-hosted instance. (Go, official)
- [Mac MCP](https://github.com/bulutarkan/mac-mcp): Local-first macOS MCP server for controlling browser tabs, Mac apps, files and terminal. (Python)

- [MCP Production Kit](https://github.com/A7mdMe/mcp-production-kit): Enterprise TypeScript starter kit for building production MCP servers with dual stdio/SSE transports, SSRF defense, memory store, and Docker support. (TypeScript)
- [mcp-pool](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus/mcp-pool): MCP Key Pool Proxy — pool multiple API keys across upstream MCP servers to distribute rate limits. One subprocess per pool, lazy failover, per-key cooldown. (TypeScript)
- [NAIF Gravity](https://naifgravity.com): Hosted MCP diagnostics for API authentication, webhooks, and AI-agent integration failures, with bounded repair workflows based on sanitized evidence; free triage and optional paid repairs. (Other, official)
- [Nicelydone](https://github.com/nicelydoneapp/mcp): Search web app screens, UI elements, and user flows for design research. Requires Nicelydone Premium. (Other, official)
- [Oh My Android](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android): Native macOS app with a built-in MCP server that lets AI agents see and drive the Android Emulator and adb devices: screenshots, UI tree in dp, taps, logcat, dark mode, font scale, and locale. (Swift)
- [Openhook](https://github.com/openhook-dev/openhook-inbox): Open-source webhook inbox for AI agents to capture callbacks, inspect payloads, and wait for events over MCP; hosted or self-hosted, with private per-inbox access tokens. (Python, official)
- [OverlayQA](https://github.com/OverlayQA/mcp): Runs WCAG accessibility (axe-core), color-contrast and design-token audits on any public URL and files the findings as QA issues in OverlayQA. (TypeScript, official)
- [POSH](https://github.com/skatkov/posh-mcp): Search and read local Ruby and gem documentation matched to project versions; proprietary POSH agent-tools license required. (Go, official)
- [Postman MCP Server](https://github.com/postmanlabs/postman-mcp-server): Explore and run Postman collections and API workflows from AI clients. (TypeScript, official)
- [REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea): Local CLI and MCP server for agent-assisted reverse engineering of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, and .NET assemblies. (TypeScript)
- [ReMCP](https://github.com/getremcp/remcp): Securely access computers explicitly paired to your account through a hosted OAuth MCP connection, including state-changing file, terminal, browser, and desktop tools. (TypeScript, official)
- [RoboParts](https://github.com/lm203688/roboparts): Vendor-neutral robot hardware compatibility checker across 868 entities with three-state verdicts and ISO 9409-1 flange anchor. (JavaScript, official)
- [SanctionsKit Developer MCP](https://www.sanctionskit.com/resources/mcp): Public SanctionsKit documentation, API schemas, and request validation, with authenticated synthetic sandbox tools for building sanctions screening integrations. (Other, official)
- [Semgrep MCP Server](https://github.com/semgrep/semgrep/tree/develop/cli/src/semgrep/mcp): Run static analysis and security scans on codebases via Semgrep. (Python, official)
- [Sentry MCP Server](https://docs.sentry.io/product/sentry-mcp/): Investigate errors, releases, and performance issues in Sentry. (TypeScript, official)
- [SFXMint](https://github.com/flreey/sfxmint-mcp): Find CC0 sound effects by event, set or description and retrieve audio URLs without a key; optional custom generation requires a key and paid pass or plan. (TypeScript, official)
- [SheetsData](https://sheetsdata.com): Electronic component datasheets for AI agents: pinouts, specs, package info and design checks from manufacturer PDFs, with part search across JLCPCB, Mouser and DigiKey; hosted, OAuth or API key, paid per call. (Python, official)
- [SkillDB](https://github.com/devchad-cmd/skilldb-sdk): Search reusable AI agent skills through an installable TypeScript MCP server; full skill content requires a Pro or Studio account. (TypeScript, official)
- [Sourcegraph Cody MCP](https://sourcegraph.com/docs/api/mcp): Code intelligence and search across large codebases with Cody. (TypeScript, official)
- [Spinnaker MCP Server](https://github.com/GeiserX/spinnaker-mcp): Read and operate a Spinnaker instance through its Gate API: 37 tools for applications, pipelines, executions, deployment strategies, and infrastructure, plus a read-only toolset. (Go)
- [Tavero](https://github.com/baccaraaa/tavero): Scans a running React 19 app (Vite or Next.js) for UI drift in buttons, cards, colors, and spacing, and returns fixes with file and line references to the coding agent. (TypeScript)
- [UI Verify MCP Server](https://uiverify.ai/docs/triage-with-your-agent): Review a pull request's visual diffs, read the AI judge's verdict on each change, and accept new baselines in UI Verify from a coding agent. (TypeScript, official)
- [Vibe Monitor](https://github.com/tubban1/vibe-monitor): Local architecture checkpoints for AI coding agents; read-only source analysis and practical advice (Node 22+; default-on pseudonymous telemetry, required for Free analysis). (JavaScript)
- [vibe-testing](https://github.com/AishwaryShrivastav/vibe-testing): Scan web app routes and forms, run Playwright browser checks, and produce HTML QA reports through a local MCP server. (TypeScript)

## Browsers, Search, and Web Automation

- [2Captcha MCP](https://github.com/2captcha/2captcha-mcp): Scrape pages past anti-bot protection, parse marketplaces into JSON, automate a browser, and solve CAPTCHAs. (JavaScript, official)
- [402registry](https://402registry.com): Remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, no key) to look up whether AI crawlers can see a website, with prices, docs and service status; the paid check ($0.01 over x402) stays plain HTTP. (TypeScript, official)
- [agbrowser](https://agbrowser.shveik.dev): Hosted browser sessions for agents: navigate, interact, read pages and take screenshots. Session purchases and extensions use stablecoins over x402 or MPP on Base; browser operations use session credentials. (Go, official)
- [agdata](https://agdata.shveik.dev): Pay-per-call web data for agents: any URL as Markdown, screenshots, YouTube transcripts and comments, Maps and Amazon reviews, jobs, news, search; paid with x402 stablecoins, no API key. (Go, official)
- [AgentRender](https://github.com/corbinvachal48/agentrender-mcp): Turns a URL into a screenshot, PDF, or structured extract (title, text, links) via a hosted render API. Local `uvx agentrender-mcp` or remote endpoint; free API key, no card. (Python, official)
- [agproxy](https://agproxy.shveik.dev): Pay-per-call residential proxy traffic and raw fetch for agents, with country targeting and sticky sessions; paid with x402 stablecoins, no API key. (Go, official)
- [AI观潮 News MCP](https://aiguanchao.com/en/agent): Curated AI news, daily briefs, trending stories and an LLM leaderboard; summaries in Chinese with source links. Needs a personal token (free daily quota). (Go, official)
- [Apify MCP Server](https://github.com/apify/apify-mcp-server): Run Apify Actors and extract web datasets at scale. (TypeScript, official)
- [Arcmira: YouTube Transcript Search](https://arcmira.com/docs/mcp-server): Search indexed YouTube transcripts for timestamped passages, speaker appearances, mentions, sponsors and recommendations over a hosted MCP connection. (Other, official)
- [Baizhi Cloud Agent Toolkit](https://github.com/chaitin/baizhi-agent-toolkit): Hosted web search, page reading and structured extraction over Streamable HTTP; the hosted backend source is closed, this repository contains MIT configs, docs and tests, and access needs your own API key and may consume credits. (Other, official)
- [Baizhi Cloud Browser (CapyBrowser)](https://github.com/chaitin/baizhi-cloud-browser): Manage cloud browser sessions, saved profiles, human handoff and downloads via hosted MCP; page actions require a CDP client, and a Baizhi API key and paid browser runtime apply. (Other)
- [BGPT MCP](https://bgpt.pro/mcp/): Search full-text scientific papers and return structured evidence for research agents. (Python)
- [Brave Search MCP Server](https://github.com/brave/brave-search-mcp-server): Privacy-focused web and local search through the Brave Search API. (TypeScript, official)
- [Browser MCP](https://github.com/browsermcp/mcp): Automate a local Chrome browser from MCP-compatible AI clients. (TypeScript, official)
- [Browser Use MCP Server](https://docs.browser-use.com/cloud/guides/mcp-server): Hosted MCP server that runs browser agent tasks in Browser Use stealth cloud browsers and returns results, sessions, and saved browser profiles. (Python, official)
- [browser-buddy](https://github.com/hahahahahahahahah6/browser-buddy): MCP server plus Chrome extension that lets coding agents read the user's real, logged-in browser pages. (Python)
- [Browserbase MCP Server](https://github.com/browserbase/mcp-server-browserbase): Cloud browser automation for navigation, scraping, and form filling. (TypeScript, official)
- [BusyBee](https://github.com/danfeistar/busybee-mcp): Hosted remote MCP server for public social media data across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Douyin and Xiaohongshu: search posts and creators, read post detail, pull comments and comment insights, and read trending topics. (Python)
- [Chrome DevTools MCP](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp): Control and inspect Chrome through DevTools protocol for debugging and automation. (TypeScript, official)
- [CloakBrowser MCP](https://github.com/swimmwatch/cloakbrowser-mcp): Runs upstream Playwright MCP with CloakBrowser Chromium, preserving its browser tools and adding bridge diagnostics. (TypeScript)
- [Cluefinch MCP](https://github.com/cluefinch/mcp-server): Local-first MCP server for AI-agent web research with search, incremental page reading, link navigation, and multi-source evidence collection. (Python, official)
- [CodeTrendy](https://codetrendy.com/mcp): Read-only MCP server for the CodeTrendy startup discovery directory: search 682 listed websites, SaaS and AI tools, read full listing profiles, find alternatives to a product and see what is trending; no API key, no account. (TypeScript, official)
- [ContHunt](https://github.com/Synthenova/conthunt-mcp): Discover and research viral social content on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. (Other, official)
- [crawlbrulee mcp server](https://github.com/crawlbrulee/crawlbrulee-mcp): Scrape any page into clean markdown, screenshots, metadata and links, or map a site's urls, with an EU-hosted web scraping api. (TypeScript, official)
- [crawlerpeek](https://github.com/crawlerpeek/crawlerpeek): Check whether AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot can access a URL: robots.txt rules per bot (RFC 9309) plus the live HTTP status fetched with each bot's user agent. (TypeScript)
- [CurlShot](https://curlshot.com/docs): Hosted screenshot API over remote MCP: renders any public URL as PNG, JPEG, WebP, PDF or a scrolling video, full page or at a device preset. API key as Bearer token; free plan 100 screenshots/month, no card. (TypeScript, official)
- [Exa MCP Server](https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server): Neural and keyword web search optimized for AI research workflows. (TypeScript, official)
- [Firecrawl MCP Server](https://github.com/mendableai/firecrawl-mcp-server): Scrape, crawl, and extract structured web data with Firecrawl. (TypeScript, official)
- [Hyperresearch](https://hyperresearch.ai/docs/mcp): Hyperresearch is an AI deep research API. One question in, an adversarially reviewed report out, cited claims checked against their sources. (Other)
- [Karma.Domains Expired Domains](https://karma.domains/en/expired-domains-mcp/): Hosted server to search expired, auction and backorder domains with SEO metrics, Wayback history and live WHOIS/DNS checks; OAuth or API key, Pro plan required. (Other, official)
- [LifeVerse Product Discovery](https://github.com/lifeversegu/lifeverse-mcp): Discover, search, inspect, and recommend eleven public LifeVerse AI products and interactive experiences through four read-only tools. (TypeScript, official)
- [looot](https://github.com/loootai/looot-mcp): Hosted remote MCP server to search, price and run 2,500+ data API endpoints from 90+ providers with one key and a prepaid balance. (TypeScript, official)
- [MEDIAPRONET](https://mediapronet.com/mcp): Read-only MCP server for the MEDIAPRONET directory: search 249 listed websites, SaaS and AI tools, read full listing profiles, find alternatives to a product and see what is trending; no API key, no account. (TypeScript, official)
- [Perceptlayer](https://docs.perceptlayer.com/ai-agents): Searches and calls 1,659 data endpoints across 248 websites (maps, real estate, jobs, travel, search) over a hosted MCP endpoint and returns structured JSON; free tier included. (JavaScript, official)
- [Playwright MCP](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp): Official Microsoft Playwright server for browser automation via accessibility snapshots. (TypeScript, official)
- [Puppeteer MCP Server](https://github.com/merajmehrabi/puppeteer-mcp-server): Headless Chrome automation using Puppeteer for scraping and testing. (TypeScript)
- [rea-captcha](https://github.com/masakaai/rea-captcha): MCP server that completes authorized test or owned verification flows in an agent's existing Playwright or CDP session, then resumes after fresh server validation. (TypeScript, official)
- [RecordHTML](https://recordhtml.com/mcp): Record public web pages or HTML5 creatives (banners, ads, animations) to MP4, WebM or GIF in a real browser and get a signed video link; remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 or an API key. (TypeScript, official)
- [Rolês em SP](https://rolesemsp.com.br/connect.md): Curated São Paulo cultural outing discovery through a hosted MCP endpoint requiring OAuth. (JavaScript, official)
- [Shortform Kit](https://shortformkit.com/mcp-server/): Read, download and Whisper-transcribe public Instagram Reels, TikToks and YouTube videos, plus sourced 2026 upload specs and creator data; free, no key. (Python, official)
- [SitePatent](https://sitepatent.com/mcp): Read-only MCP server for the SitePatent product discovery directory: search the websites, SaaS and AI tools listed there, read full listing profiles, find alternatives to a product and see what is trending; no API key, no account. (TypeScript, official)
- [Solvecha](https://solvecha.com/mcp-captcha-solver): Solves reCAPTCHA v2 image grids, text captchas, GeeTest sliders and FunCAPTCHA for AI agents over a hosted MCP endpoint; free tier included. (Go, official)
- [Surface](https://github.com/Surface-ops/surface): URL preflight for agents: preflight_url unwraps short links, follows redirects, refuses private hosts, and returns the final URL with next: fetch or skip. Never returns the page body; no API key. (JavaScript, official)
- [Tavily MCP Server](https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp): AI-native search and content extraction for research agents. (Python, official)
- [toolkb-mcp](https://github.com/jack-reson8/toolkb-mcp): Local server that returns YouTube transcripts and playlists, web pages as Markdown and App Store reviews, with no API key or account. (JavaScript)
- [TubeText TikTok Transcripts & Video Breakdown](https://github.com/LMSlay/tubetext-mcp/tree/main/registry/tiktok-transcripts): TikTok video transcripts (captions or Whisper AI) plus AI hook, shot list and script breakdown. Hosted on Apify (OAuth), pay per result. (Other, official)
- [TubeText YouTube Transcripts & Channel Analytics](https://github.com/LMSlay/tubetext-mcp/tree/main/registry/youtube-transcripts): YouTube transcripts from videos, Shorts, playlists or channels, plus channel and Social Blade stats. Hosted on Apify (OAuth), pay per result. (Other, official)
- [WebExtract](https://github.com/nyx464664816-stack/webextract): Turns a public URL into structured JSON (product, tables, metadata) plus clean Markdown. 20 free calls a day per caller IP, then x402 USDC or credits. Sandbox benchmark, 10 pages: markdown 38/40, extract 40/40 (webextract.dev/benchmark). (Other, official)

## Finance, Commerce, and Business Apps

- [3Descu 3D Printing Quotes (EU)](https://quote.3descu.com/ai-agents/): Instant FDM and SLA 3D printing quotes from an ISO 9001:2015 certified EU factory: list materials, measure an STL or OBJ link and get a price in EUR. (TypeScript, official)
- [402post](https://402post.com): Remote MCP server (streamable HTTP, no key) for paid classified listings for agents: list categories, validate, create, search and read listings; a listing costs $0.03 for 30 days over x402. (TypeScript, official)
- [Account Executive Jobs](https://github.com/854Labs/account-executive-jobs): Hosted OAuth MCP server to search and apply to account executive and sales jobs, and for employers to manage job posts and applicants. (Other, official)
- [AccountsOS](https://github.com/thriveventurelabs/accountsos-mcp-server): AI accounting MCP server: query your live AccountsOS books (balances, transactions, VAT, deadlines, invoices, documents) from any MCP client. (TypeScript, official)
- [ADEXTO](https://github.com/0xcuy/adexto): Bonding-curve token markets on Monad, Arbitrum One, Base, Robinhood Chain and 0G: list and price markets, buy with USDC on Base over x402, and prepare launch, stake and claim transactions for your own key. (TypeScript, official)
- [AdsTurbo](https://adsturbo.ai): Create ecommerce video ads and product images: clone a reference ad around a product, AI actor videos, text/image-to-video, lip sync and video translation, over remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 or an API key. (Other, official)
- [Agent Payment Node](https://github.com/nuanu-ai/agent-payment-node): Local CLI and stdio MCP payment tools for AI agents on macOS Apple Silicon, with foreground human approval for signing. (TypeScript, official)
- [AgentServices](https://github.com/vbkotecha/agentservices-api): Paid API platform for AI agents — crypto prices, DeFi yields, market indicators, dispute resolution, and on-chain analytics via x402 micropayments. (Python)
- [agosint](https://agosint.shveik.dev): Company and domain due diligence for AI agents: legal entity from official registers, LEI, EU VAT, sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UK) and domain checks, every answer signed. Pay per call in stablecoins with x402 or MPP, no account. (Go, official)
- [agpay](https://agpay.shveik.dev): Payments held between two agents: the buyer pays by x402 or MPP, the seller proves its wallet and delivers, the buyer confirms and the seller is paid; disputes are decided by hand. Paid in stablecoins, no account. (Go, official)
- [APISign](https://apisign.io/docs/api/mcp): Hosted MCP server for legally binding e-signature: create contracts from Markdown templates or .docx, email them to signers, track views and signatures, and get signed PDFs with a SHA-256 seal and audit trail. (TypeScript, official)
- [Ariadne for Therapists](https://github.com/bgrieco22/ariadne-mcp): Audit a therapy practice's Google Business Profile and website with prioritized fixes, and write a sample Google Business post in the therapist's voice; never recommends soliciting client reviews. (TypeScript, official)
- [Astral Twin](https://astraldaily.com): Create and mint NFT asset packs on the Base blockchain from AI clients. (Other, official)
- [ATS Zero-Browser Gateway](https://github.com/ginugokz/ats-zero-browser-gateway): Protocol scraper and MCP server for Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters with deterministic ADDED/REMOVED/UPDATED delta tracking, runnable standalone or on Apify. (Python, official)
- [Award Travel Finder](https://github.com/AwardTravelFinder/mcp): Search award flight availability and points pricing across 27 airlines and 23 loyalty programs from any MCP client. (Other, official)
- [AyHire](https://ayhire.com/agents.md): Hosted OAuth MCP server to find, judge and shortlist engineers for a role from their public GitHub work, with links to the evidence for each pick. (Other, official)
- [BankBridge](https://bankbridge.money): Hosted MCP server that gives an agent read-only access to your own bank, credit card, and brokerage accounts: balances, transactions, spending summaries, recurring charges, cashflow, and investment holdings. (TypeScript, official)
- [Best Electrician Jobs](https://github.com/854Labs/best-electrician-jobs): Hosted OAuth MCP server for employers to manage electrician job posts and applicants on BestElectricianJobs.com: draft and publish jobs, read résumés and move candidates through hiring. (Other, official)
- [Bilbop x402](https://github.com/bilbop1/bilbop-x402-mcp): Pay-per-call agent tools paid in USDC on Solana over x402, no account or API key: text summarize, Solana token brief and mint info, text-to-speech, and human brand feedback. (JavaScript, official)
- [BirkinBagStock](https://birkinbagstock.com/llms.txt): Independent Hermès resale listings, price comparisons, and price alerts. (Other, official)
- [BKK Staff](https://app.bkkstaff.com/mcp): Automated resume screening for small businesses: create and manage job posts, rank applicants (strong/possible/weak), search candidates and email applicants via a hosted OAuth MCP server. (Other, official)
- [BlockVectra](https://github.com/blockvectra/mcp): Remote MCP server for multi-chain EVM JSON-RPC, an indexed Data API, documentation, pricing and status, for developers and AI agents. Documentation, chain and status tools need no API key; Data API tools require one. (Other, official)
- [Buy-Box](https://buybox.agentconsult.ai): Saves your buying criteria for homes, cars or any category (budget, must-haves, dealbreakers) so AI agents load them before they search and rank listings against them. (Other, official)
- [BuyWhere MCP](https://github.com/BuyWhere/buywhere-mcp): Hosted product-search MCP server for multi-merchant price comparison across Singapore, SEA, and US catalogs. (TypeScript, official)
- [canli-validation-mcp](https://github.com/arhancanli/canli-validation-mcp): Checks whether a backtest result is real or just the luckiest of the variants tried: deflated Sharpe ratio, CSCV overfitting probability, data-snooping tests, lookahead checks and pipeline placebos. (JavaScript, official)
- [Checkout Page](https://checkoutpage.com/mcp?utm_source=mcphq&utm_medium=listing): Create and manage checkout pages, events, forms, products, coupons, customers, payments and subscriptions on Checkout Page, a checkout platform on Stripe Connect, over remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth. (TypeScript, official)
- [Chord](https://github.com/getchordlabs/chord): Hosted MCP server with no API key for data: best-route DEX swap quotes and unsigned transactions on 7 EVM chains (Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and more), plus token boards, candles, wallet PnL and smart money. Non-custodial. (TypeScript, official)
- [Clera](https://github.com/getclera/mcp): Search 210,000+ vetted startup candidates, review Clera's picks for your open roles, and request intros through a hosted OAuth MCP server. (TypeScript, official)
- [CreditUnions](https://creditunions.fyi): Query federally insured US credit unions from NCUA call report data by city and state: charter, field of membership, assets, members and branches. (TypeScript)
- [Crevio](https://crevio.co/docs/developer/mcp): Delegate work to an AI agent that runs your small business (products, orders, customers, email, sites), or run scripts against the Crevio API and 3,000+ connected apps. (Ruby, official)
- [Datacircle](https://datacircle.dev/docs/mcp): Datacircle lists all the GTM APIs. Our MCP server is open to anyone, with no key: add api.datacircle.dev/mcp to Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. (Python, official)
- [datawebot](https://github.com/datawebot/datawebot-mcp): Hosted product search and seller prices across online shops worldwide, plus extraction jobs for Amazon and Shopify pages, over remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth or an API key. (Other, official)
- [Dexra](https://github.com/dexra-dev/mcp): Read-only risk verdicts (ok, caution or avoid, with reasons) for Solana launches, tokens, wallets, pools and planned swaps, via an API key with a free daily allowance or keyless x402 pay-per-call in USDC. (JavaScript, official)
- [Dropify](https://github.com/xozxro/dropify-mcp): Looks up the official merch stores Dropify tracks for an artist or brand and returns the page where restock and drop alerts are set. (TypeScript, official)
- [Edgrapi](https://edgrapi.com): US government data as JSON: SAM.gov contract opportunities, USAspending awards, Grants.gov grants, House STOCK Act trades and SEC EDGAR filings, 19 read-only tools. (Python, official)
- [Elori](https://github.com/elori-debug/elori-mcp): Hosted sales pipeline, contacts and meeting workflows via approved Elori actions; OAuth and a verified Director or Autopilot account required. (TypeScript, official)
- [Equibles](https://equibles.com/mcp): Hosted MCP server for US company fundamentals as reported in SEC filings, filing text, earnings-call transcripts, 13F holdings and insider trades, with OAuth or API-key access. (C#, official)
- [Feminiq Rides](https://www.feminiqrides.nl/llms.txt): Remote server for an Amsterdam chauffeur service with a female driver option: list routes, tours and cars, get a price quote and send a ride request. (JavaScript, official)
- [Fincept MCP](https://github.com/Fincept-Corporation/fincept-mcp-docs): Hosted MCP server for Fincept Terminal: quotes, candles, option chains, fundamentals, economic data, SEC filings, news, backtests, paper trading and 15 quant engines, with OAuth sign-in. (Other, official)
- [Finder Jobs](https://mcp.finder.work): Job vacancies and salary stats for Russia, Kazakhstan, Belarus, Kyrgyzstan, Germany, France, Belgium, Switzerland, Sweden and Indonesia. Free, read-only, no auth. (Python, official)
- [FirstSales MCP](https://developer.firstsales.io/agents/mcp-server): Retrieve CRM contacts, deals, lists and workflows, and create contacts in approved workspaces via hosted OAuth MCP; requires an eligible paid FirstSales plan. (TypeScript, official)
- [Flight Seatmap](https://flightseatmap.com/mcp): Seat maps, seat ratings, traveller reviews and seat alerts for 100+ airlines, as a hosted remote MCP server. (Other, official)
- [foto foto](https://github.com/nternet-company/fotofoto-mcp): Turn your photos or a public iCloud Shared Album into a printed hardcover photo book, and compare photo book prices across services. (Other, official)
- [Frantic](https://github.com/gofrantic/frantic-mcp): Read the bounty board and agent standing, then use authenticated tools to post funded work, claim bounties, and deliver results. (TypeScript, official)
- [Glongus MCP](https://github.com/glongusmain/glongus-mcp): Lets an agent buy and sell physical goods on the Glongus UK marketplace, with haggling, escrow, shipping and seller reputation. (JavaScript, official)
- [Google Hotels](https://github.com/huynhtanan/google-hotels-mcp): Live Google Hotels and Vacation Rentals search with per-OTA nightly rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, Vrbo, Airbnb, Hotels.com and more) plus a 3-month daily price calendar. Pay-per-use via Apify (bring your own APIFY_TOKEN). (Python)
- [Grey Ridge x402 Market & DeFi Data](https://github.com/rezearcher/x402-data-api): Keyless Base market data for agents: live DeFi yields, perp funding rates, crypto spot prices, Polymarket odds and a pre-trade token-safety gate. Free preview tools; paid calls settle per request in USDC via x402, no key or account. (TypeScript)
- [helloasso-mcp](https://github.com/edouard-claude/helloasso-mcp): HelloAsso for French associations: members, event tickets, donations, payments, refunds and checkout links, covering all 36 routes of the v5 API. (Rust)
- [HireFerry](https://github.com/TokenNotIncluded/hireferry): Self-hostable talent matching platform with read-only MCP search for public jobs and opt-in résumés, plus authenticated tools for hiring workflows. (Rust)
- [HireLayer](https://github.com/HireLayer/hirelayer-mcp): Parse resumes and CVs into structured JSON, extract weighted criteria from a job description, match and rank candidates with per-criterion explanations, and normalize skills. (TypeScript, official)
- [HubSpot MCP Server](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/apps/developer-platform/build-apps/integrate-with-the-remote-hubspot-mcp-server): Access HubSpot contacts, deals, and marketing automation data. (TypeScript, official)
- [Invompt](https://mcp.invompt.com/mcp): Turn AI-host work into invoices you review before send — Continue as guest or OAuth via hosted MCP. Site https://www.invompt.com (TypeScript, official)
- [Jet Cab AMS](https://www.jetcabams.nl/llms.txt): Remote server for an Amsterdam chauffeur service: list Schiphol transfer routes, tours and cars, get an exact price quote and send a booking request. (JavaScript, official)
- [Kandle](https://github.com/Kernel-Hunter/kandle): Lets an agent drive candlestick charts for crypto, stocks and forex in an open browser tab: read candles and indicator values, draw levels, set alerts, run scripts and strategy backtests, and take screenshots. (TypeScript, official)
- [Kooperativa.io](https://github.com/kooperativa-team/kooperativa-mcp): People and company data from Kooperativa.io: enrich and search profiles, hiring signals, job changes, headcount by seniority and webhook monitors. (TypeScript, official)
- [Landed MCP](https://github.com/landedjobs/landed-mcp): Search AI and tech jobs ranked against a role brief, read a job's application form fields, and fetch free interview prep through a hosted MCP endpoint. (TypeScript, official)
- [Leal](https://www.getleal.com/mcp): Design and launch Apple Wallet and Google Wallet loyalty stamp cards for shops and cafés: brand kit from a website, live pass previews, rewards, QR signup posters. (Ruby, official)
- [Live Tennis API MCP](https://www.npmjs.com/package/livetennisapi-mcp): Real-time tennis match state — score, current server, three-valued break-point flag, and retirement/walkover/completed status — plus players, rankings, Elo, and fixtures across ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF, and juniors. (TypeScript)
- [MAQAMI Travel](https://github.com/negm17111995/mcp-server): Search hotels (3M+) and flights, read hotel details and reviews, then send the customer a secure checkout link on book.maqami.co for the chosen offer; payment is taken only there. Hosted, no API key. (JavaScript, official)
- [MCP Ads](https://mcp-ads.com): Read and manage Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn and Microsoft Ads plus GA4, Search Console and Tag Manager: reports, audits and campaign edits (new campaigns start paused), over Streamable HTTP with OAuth. (Python, official)
- [MedBillAnalyzer](https://medbillanalyzer.com): Checks a medical bill against the insurer's Explanation of Benefits and reports where they disagree; free summary, optional $10-per-bill unlock for full detail and a dispute letter. (TypeScript, official)
- [MoltNode by Chord](https://github.com/tuantqse90/moltnode-mcp): Hosted MCP server with no API key: read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Monad, Sui and more) and get DEX swap quotes with unsigned transactions via Chord. Non-custodial: the agent signs with its own key. (Other, official)
- [Noonlaunch](https://github.com/mukund1158/noonlaunch-mcp): Launch a product on Noonlaunch, search its product directory and weekly winners, and find 333 startup launch directories; hosted, no API key or account needed to connect. (PHP, official)
- [NotFair](https://github.com/nowork-studio/NotFair): Open-source Claude Code agent skills for SEO, GEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads, connecting to live data via Google Ads MCP, Meta Ads MCP, Google Search Console MCP, and Google Analytics (GA4) MCP. (TypeScript)
- [OutreachGenie](https://github.com/Outreachgenie/outreachgenie-linkedin-mcp): Manage saved prospects, lists, outreach flows and campaign drafts in an OutreachGenie workspace over hosted MCP; requires an account and OAuth or a bearer API key, with broader permissions for API keys. (TypeScript, official)
- [Panda Greetings](https://www.pandagreetings.com/ai-assistants): Finds ready-made greeting card designs for an occasion with your message placed inside, each linking to its page to order it printed and mailed in the US; free hosted server, no sign-in. (JavaScript, official)
- [PandaStock](https://github.com/D-Asce/pandastocksdk): A-share real-time market data MCP server with NATS-pushed quotes, Level2, DDX big orders, money flow and AI stock screening; 176 server-side endpoints, 22 open endpoints, free public test account. (Python)
- [PayPal MCP Server](https://github.com/paypal/agent-toolkit): Process PayPal payments and manage merchant operations. (TypeScript, official)
- [Pink Agentic AI Payments](https://pinkwallet.com/agentic/developers/): Approval layer for AI agent payments: per-agent budgets and rules return allow (single-use credential), ask a human, or block before money moves, over remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1; public sandbox with test money only. - [Pocket Drives](https://github.com/RevList/pocket-drives-mcp): Search, quote, and browse luxury, exotic, and EV rentals from independent hosts. Location autocomplete, availability, and airport/venue delivery. Booking finishes in the iOS app. (TypeScript)

## Utilities and Examples

- [A2ASearch MCP](https://github.com/tadas-github/a2asearch-mcp): Search thousands of MCP servers, agents, and CLI tools by capability. (TypeScript)
- [AgentFEM MCP](https://github.com/haoming-luo/agentfem-mcp): Create, validate and run finite-element projects and inspect numerical results through local stdio tools, with a separately installed compatible AgentFEM scientific runtime. (Python, official)
- [Airport Lounge List MCP Server](https://github.com/Airport-Lounge-List/mcp-server): Hosted server for searching 8,500+ airport lounges and checking access by card or membership. (Ruby, official)
- [Anyquery](https://github.com/julien040/anyquery): Query 40+ apps and databases with SQL from a single local binary. (Go)
- [CareClinic Health Tracker](https://github.com/tandemloop/careclinic_mcp): Track symptoms, mood, medications, and wellness patterns through a remote OAuth MCP server. (Other)
- [Everything2MCP](https://github.com/shcdwz1234/Everything2MCP): Turn local capabilities, private-net services, OpenAPI/gRPC/MQTT/queues, and Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom into one MCP surface with hot-reload and Safe defaults. (TypeScript)
- [FastMCP](https://github.com/jlowin/fastmcp): Python framework for building MCP servers quickly with decorators. (Python)
- [FaviconDL](https://github.com/sweesama/favicondl.com): Extract and download website favicons via MCP; wraps the free no-key FaviconDL API. (JavaScript)
- [genealogy-mcp](https://github.com/igormel81/genealogy-mcp): Family history research with 79 archives and databases, name variants, historical calendars, evidence checks, GEDCOM audit, and archive-request drafts. Runs locally without API keys or network requests. (Python)
- [Google Maps MCP Server](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived/tree/main/src/google-maps): Geocoding, directions, and place search via Google Maps. (Python)
- [Ignav Flights](https://github.com/gusgordon/ignav-skill): Search live flight prices, compare departure dates, resolve airports, and get booking links. (Python, official)
- [MCP Server Starter](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/create-typescript-server): Official TypeScript scaffold for creating new MCP servers. (TypeScript, official)
- [MCP Server Templates](https://github.com/Data-Everything/mcp-server-templates): Unified MCP platform connecting many apps behind one interface. (TypeScript)
- [mcp-trellis](https://github.com/amir1824/mcp-trellis): Zero-dependency TypeScript library that ships an MCP handler and OAuth 2.1 authorization server in one package for Claude, Gemini, and Codex connectors. (TypeScript)
- [MCPJungle](https://github.com/duaraghav8/MCPJungle): Self-hosted MCP server registry for enterprise AI agent deployments. (Go)
- [MetaMCP](https://github.com/metatool-ai/metatool-app): Middleware MCP server that aggregates and manages multiple connections. (TypeScript)
- [Nestbolt](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt): Nests 2D SVG/DXF parts on fixed sheets for laser, CNC, plasma and waterjet cutting, with validated layouts and per-sheet SVG/DXF export. (Rust)
- [QRX](https://qrx.codes/developers/mcp): Creates artistic, print-ready QR codes from a prompt and a link, checks that each one decodes before returning it, and serves it through a hosted qrx.to short link. (TypeScript, official)
- [TableJourney](https://github.com/lewismvaughan/tablejourney-mcp): Where to eat in 222 cities, signature dishes, and dates of the next edition of 1,480 food festivals, each place with the source it was checked against; hosted, no auth. (Python, official)
- [Weather MCP Server](https://github.com/isdaniel/mcp_weather_server): Fetch current weather and forecasts from public weather APIs. (Python)
- [Wheremind](https://wheremind.ai): Hosted maps MCP server for AI agents: live place search, place details, nearby search, geocoding, and directions, with no Maps API key to manage. (Other, official)

## Optional

- [mcpHQ directory](https://mcphq.org/): Searchable website for this catalog, with a page and install configs for every server.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mcpHQ/awesome-mcp-servers): Catalog source, README, and issue templates.
- [Contributing guide](https://github.com/mcpHQ/awesome-mcp-servers/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add or update a server.
- [MCP specification](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/latest): The Model Context Protocol specification.
- [Official MCP registry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/): Official registry of publicly available MCP servers.
- [Reference servers](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers): Official example MCP servers.
